units.translation: It seems to be correctly understood of beams and other fragments of ships scattered through the sea, which interpretation fits the preceding narrative of the messenger. Strangely the scholiast thought of the ebb and flow of the sea, ὡς ἂν εἴποι τις διαύλοις [as one might say, in double channels]. For the waves pour out and recede; and by διπλάκεσσι [double folds] he means the two surfaces of sea and land. Or in Salamis and Plataea. To Hermann Aeschylus seemed to have spoken of the wide garments of the Persians which, spread out over the dead floating in the sea, were carried here and there; which indeed agrees with the Homeric use of the word for a doubled cloak, but it is not likely that it came to the mind of Aeschylus and the spectators of this play.

Thus I emended what in M is ἐπιδιπλοΐζω [to double upon].
For a hostile arrow, sitting upon the heart, doubles the burden of disease for the one who possesses it.
Farewell, farewell again; I double the word.
where it is not apparent why ἐγὼ διπλᾶς δέ [I double... but] was said, when more suitably ἐγὼ δὲ διπλᾶς [but I double] could have been written, which meter he used in the resolved form
to say double things, and to see double things
it was a double front of two armies
the sons of Priam paid double penalties
for the sound of this double lash reaches me
a double lion, a double Ares
and there is also a double dwelling
do not, Prometheus, impose double roads upon me
so that double wolves carry the fawn
where it is explained by Hesychius through διπλαῖ [double] (or διπλοῖ [twofold]?).

so as to balance these with double weight

of the double-throned and double-sceptered honor from Zeus
where I restored λήμασιν ἴσους [equal in spirit].
